title: Preceptor limit on directly supervised pharmacy interns
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 8.01(16) a registered pharmacist preceptor shall not directly supervise more than two pharmacy interns at one time. Separately, 247 CMR 8.01(15) allows a pharmacy intern who is acting under the direct supervision of a registered pharmacist preceptor to supervise pharmacy technicians.
exam_relevance: Tests the preceptor-side cap on interns and the distinct fact that a supervised intern may itself supervise technicians, rather than the overall support-personnel ratio.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

numeric_facts.fact: maximum interns directly supervised by one preceptor

common_confusions: The two-intern preceptor cap is separate from the overall supervisory ratio in 247 CMR 8.06(3).
An intern supervising technicians does not stop the intern from needing direct preceptor supervision.
verification_notes: Read in the current official Board of Registration in Pharmacy publication of 247 CMR 8.00 on 2026-08-19 during Batch 3 tranche B3-A authoring under Issue #91. A fresh independent legal and full-bank realism audit is still required before release.
